rollout_safety_constraints.policy: All six inherited constraint IDs from S01-S03 must propagate to this deploy. Validator V-UP-D11 enforces count == 6.

inherited_constraints.rule: no_implicit_pass_no_overclaim — deployment_status must honestly reflect preconditions; success / failed / rolled_back are not admissible when preconditions are absent
no_public_signup_probe — sign-up probe via public host is forbidden; reverse-proxy lockdown is presumed-untouched but not re-verified in this slice
no_paperclip_api_key_auth — auth must be session-cookie-only; deploy verification never sets or echoes PAPERCLIP_API_KEY
auto-mode_zero_capture_requires_user_confirmation — no VPS SSH, no fresh docker inspect, no authenticated API call without explicit user confirmation
no_destructive_docker_command — never run docker compose down/up/rm against live VPS in auto-mode
no_git_mutation — never run git commit / push / fetch / clone against upstream paperclip repository in auto-mode
